lines.label: What it holds

lines.value: Patient leaflets, product characteristics and public assessment reports for medicines, searchable by product name, active substance or PL number.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency

lines.value: Applicants obtain a PL number and apply to the MHRA for a marketing authorisation; an authorisation the MHRA grants covers the whole of the UK.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency

lines.value: No mandatory pack code; optional 2D Data Matrix (may include GTIN)

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency

lines.value: Since 1 January 2025 UK packs no longer carry EU safety features. Marketing authorisation holders may choose to add a 2D Data Matrix that may encode product information, expiry date, batch number, Global Trade Item Number and a serial number; it is not compulsory and must not be recognised by the European repositories system.
